counter_thesis: NVDA’s mixed HOLD is vulnerable because the $228.38 price implies a 60% five-year FCF CAGR, while the frozen inputs provide no actual or lane FCF growth estimate; the weighted fair value is $220.12, and the 10-year real yield is 2.88%. The analyst revenue path of 39.28% CAGR does not establish that FCF can meet the higher implied hurdle.
kill_conditions: IF FCF growth is below 30% annualized across the next two reported quarters WITHIN 180 days THEN the price-implied 60% five-year FCF growth case breaks.
IF year-over-year revenue growth falls below 36% in either of the next two quarterly reports WITHIN 180 days THEN the price-implied revenue path breaks.

IF the FRED 10-year real Treasury yield remains at or above 2.88% for the next 90 days THEN persistent discount-rate pressure and the $220.12 weighted fair value leave the $228.38 price without a rate-supported valuation cushion.
